version.changelog:
agenttimes 3.3.1

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates to functionality, documentation, or endpoints.
- Behavior and features remain unchanged from previous version.

llm.summary: Instruction-only news/search skill that calls a public HTTP API via curl, requests no credentials, and its requirements and instructions align with the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (news search across many feeds) matches the SKILL.md: it documents public HTTP endpoints (/ask, /news, /trending, /subscribe, etc.). The only required binary is curl, which is appropriate for making the documented HTTP calls.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to using the public agenttimes.live HTTP endpoints and example curl commands. The SKILL.md does not instruct the agent to read local files, inspect environment variables, or access unrelated system resources. The only potentially sensitive action is the subscribe endpoint which posts matching articles to a user-provided webhook URL — that webhook is supplied by the user and is expected behavior for a subscription feature.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code to write to disk (instruction-only). This is low-risk and appropriate for a simple HTTP API integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That aligns with the documentation which states free endpoints need no API key. Paid endpoints mention micropayments on Base, but the skill does not request wallet keys — handling payments is out of scope and not requested here.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default autonomous invocation settings are appropriate. The skill does not request permanent agent-wide privileges or modification of other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only integration with a public news API and requires only curl. It does not request credentials. If you use the subscribe webhook feature, point it at a server you control or trust — any data (article titles, summaries, sentiment) will be POSTed to that URL. Paid endpoints mention micropayments on Base; the skill does not manage payments or request wallet keys, so you should understand how payments are handled outside the skill before using paid features.
